macros.name: DoBraces
macros.doc: Set the delimiters to be braces.

macros.name: DoBrackets
macros.doc: Set the delimiters to be brackets.

macros.name: DoGroups
macros.doc: Set the delimiters to be parentheses.

macros.name: DoParens
macros.doc: Set the delimiters to be parentheses.

macros.name: LCschema
macros.doc: Prevent \schemabox from adding a \strut in the first line.

macros.name: SBNudgeFactor
macros.doc: Define the \kern to be added to the end of each line in one \schemabox.

macros.name: SwitchSB
macros.doc: The macro \SwitchSB toggles the insertion of a \strut to the opposite of what is in effect for just one \schemabox.

macros.name: UCschema
macros.doc: Permit \schemabox to add a \strut in the first line (default).
